::: {.lead-text}
I am a behavioural ecologist interested in how ecological and evolutionary processes shape social organization, cooperation, dispersal, and reproductive behaviour.
:::

Using long-term field studies of large carpenter bees (*Xylocopa virginica*), I investigate how individual behavioural decisions scale up to population-level patterns of social structure and social evolution.

::: {.note-box}
**Current position:** Senior Laboratory Instructor, Department of Biology, University of Victoria
:::
